# The Cap King

*A vast mushroom has grown up through the great hall of Stonecap Keep and crowned itself with everything the Shrooms have stolen. Watch the floor: the red marks show where its roots will heave and where its spores and its hoard will fall. Potions work in there; scrolls do not.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Boss | [The Cap King](../monsters/cap_king.md) |
| Arena | [The Crown Tower](../maps/crown_tower.md) |

- Unlocked by [What Drove It Out](../quests/what_drove_it_out.md)
- Entered by talking to [Hale](../npcs/hale.md)
